products.title: Coastal Linen Shirt
products.description: A relaxed oyster-white linen shirt with a camp collar, mother-of-pearl buttons, and a slightly cropped hem. Washed so it is soft on the first wear. Made for warm sidewalks and cool offices.

products.title: Driftwood Ceramic Mug
products.description: A 12oz speckled stoneware mug in warm grey, glazed inside so coffee stays hot. Each one is a little different, like driftwood. Dishwasher safe.

products.title: Tidewool Throw Blanket
products.description: A heavy merino-blend throw in tide blue, with a soft brushed face and fringe. Warm enough for a porch evening. Spot clean, or air it in the shade.

products.title: Harbor Canvas Tote
products.description: A 14oz natural canvas tote with a leather snap and an interior pocket sized for a book. Currently out of stock while the next dye lot is sewn.

products.title: Sea Salt Candle
products.description: Soy wax, cotton wick, and a clean sea-salt and driftwood scent. Burns about 45 hours. A reliable small gift.

products.title: Mariner Denim Jacket
products.description: A true-to-size indigo denim jacket with horn buttons and a corduroy collar. Unlined, so it layers over the linen shirt.

products.title: Pebble Stoneware Bowl
products.description: A shallow everyday bowl in sand glaze, good for noodles or fruit. Stacks cleanly. A small gift that gets used.

products.title: Northwind Rain Shell
products.description: A packable unisex rain shell in kelp green. Fully taped seams, one fit with an adjustable hood. Ships in one size.
